svg.title: Deployment steps and gated extensions
svg.desc: A deployment request raises OnDeploymentRequested; the pre-export gate must complete before export. For delegated stages OnApprovalStarted waits for UpdateApprovalStatus. The pre-deployment gate raises OnPreDeploymentStarted and waits for UpdatePreDeploymentStepStatus. Then OnDeploymentStarted and OnDeploymentCompleted fire. Status 10 pending, 20 complete, 30 reject.
svg.text: first stage only; runs before export
delegated stages; must use the delegate's connection
Orange = gated extension step. Each stays Pending until a flow (or any API client) calls its action:
10 = Pending (set by the system) · 20 = Complete, deployment continues · 30 = Reject, stage run fails with comments
Makers can cancel while a gate is pending. Artifacts exported once are immutable and reused for later stages.
Cedar: pre-export on Test (release notes + version), approval by Lina on Prod, pre-deploy change window on Prod.
